story.missionBrief:
=== MISSION BRIEFING ===
Role: Time Flow Coordinator
Type: RACE

Objective: Sync with 9 temporal wave fronts before time window expires
Location: Temporal flux channels, retro grid network
Threat: Collapsing time bubbles creating paradox zones
Method: Ride wave crests, avoid paradox troughs
Time Constraint: 50 seconds of stable timeline remaining

=== AVAILABLE ABILITIES ===
• Wave Ride: Surf one temporal wave front (4 seconds cooldown)
• Time Skip: Phase 2 seconds forward in time (12 seconds cooldown)
• Paradox Shield: Immune to one paradox zone [2 charges]

=== STAKES ===
Success: Time flow synchronized, sector timeline stable
Failure: Temporal collapse, sector caught in time loop
